title: Round trip times
description:
Measure the round trip time of packets and smooth it.

```
sample 100 ms -> srtt 100, rttvar 50, timeout 300
sample 120 ms -> srtt 102.5, rttvar 42.5, timeout 272.5
sample 400 ms -> srtt 139.7, rttvar 106.2 ...
```
hints: Update `rttvar` before `srtt`, because it uses the old `srtt` (lesson 5.04).
requirements: The smoothing from RFC 6298: `rttvar = 3/4 rttvar + 1/4 |srtt - sample|`, `srtt = 7/8 srtt + 1/8 sample`, `timeout = srtt + 4 rttvar`.
The first sample sets `srtt = sample` and `rttvar = sample / 2`.
Keep the timeout between 200 ms and 3000 ms.
stretch: Double the timeout after each loss (exponential backoff) and reset it after a success.
